assumptions: Tune once at 33 ft center / 10 ft outer ends, then freeze all section lengths for the five-deployment comparison; changing deployment does not require retuning.
All finished lengths are provisional model dimensions, not measured cuts; section lengths run from the feed bridge edge or link center to the next link center/end.
A 0.10 m horizontal ideal-source bridge joins symmetrical straight legs; its midpoint is 33 ft high. Bridge length and mesh are checked numerically.

The 38 mm nominal collinear electrical gap is a sensitivity assumption, not inferred from 2 mm contact diameter or insulator length. Physical tails, folds, sag, connectors and plastic insulators are omitted.
Metal bundle radius 0.2413 mm and jacket radius 0.5207 mm follow manufacturer nominal dimensions; stranded metal is represented by a round effective conductor.

Effective conductivity 10 MS/m is an uncalibrated loss proxy for copper-clad steel, bounded by 1.4 MS/m and an optimistic solid-copper 58 MS/m comparator. No copper plating thickness or permeability is known.

PE sheath is represented by lossless distributed series inductance; relative permittivity 2.3 and scaling 0 to 1.5 bound an approximate electrical-length correction, not measured dielectric properties.
Contact resistance is per closed link on each leg; baseline 0.02 ohm, sensitivity 0 to 0.5 ohm. Four contacts maximum, two on 30m, none on 20m.
Ideal balanced feedpoint and level homogeneous ground. Actual feedline/common mode, mast, coax/choke/tuner losses and connector tail routing are unspecified and omitted.
The 1.09 SWR observation at 14.135 MHz in an estimated 40 ft inverted V is context only, not a calibration target or efficiency measurement.
